abstract: Bioinformatics analyses often rely on shell commands and small shell scripts whose executable context is difficult to preserve, inspect and reuse. TAFFISH addresses this gap by packaging command-line tool calls and lightweight shell flows as installable, versioned and inspectable executable units. Through a curated public Hub, TAFFISH indexes command interfaces, execution backends, platform constraints, release metadata and smoke-test/validation records. Together, these components provide a command-level reproducibility layer that works directly in ordinary shells and can also be invoked from existing workflow systems.
